messages:
Zoe Park: quick idea — run a 45m webinar on Practical Inference Economics: how teams pick models, batching/caching levers, routing policies, and a short live demo showing cost delta. Goal = lead gen + clear buy signals from infra/platform teams. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: love it. target audience = platform/infra + ml engineers at mid-market/enterprise?
Maya Li: yep, those two. proposed speaker mix: 1) runtime/product (us) 2) bench/ML eng (bench numbers) 3) customer CS (case study: reduced token cost 3x) 4) short panel or live q&a. keep it pragmatic. :mic:
Ian Carter: run-of-show idea (lightweight):
```
00:00 - intro + why this matters (5m)
05:00 - cost vs latency narrative + tradeoffs (10m)
15:00 - benchmark walkthrough (10m)
25:00 - live demo: 2 app flows (12m)
37:00 - customer case study (6m)
43:00 - Q&A + CTA (7m)
```
Alex Gomez: inbound routing notes: registration form needs these fields: company size, role, hosting preference (hosted/dedicated/private), existing cloud. map leads to SDR queue "inbound-webinar" with tags: utm_campaign=inf-econ-webinar, tier=mid-enterprise. sample mapping snippet for ops:
```
form.company_size -> crm.field.company_size
form.hosting_pref -> crm.field.product_interest
utm_campaign -> lead.source
```
Dana R.: messaging iteration plan: A/B test subject lines (1: "Cut LLM token cost 3x without losing latency" 2: "How to make LLM inference predictable & cheap"). also two landing pages: technical (bench charts + config) vs business (case study + ROI). run for first 48 hours of promotion, measure CTR -> MQL rate.
Zoe Park: who can own speaker checklist + rehearse scheduling? need slide deck deadlines and runbook.
Maya Li: I can own speaker checklist and coordinate slides. will collect decks by Tue next week.
Samir Patel: rehearsal cadence: 1 tech check with presenters (30m) 1 full dress (45m) one week out. also 15m greenroom 10m before go-live.
Ian Carter: can we do a short benchmark vignette that we can publish as a follow-up blog? small table + takeaway bullets. helps with post-webinar nurture.
Alex Gomez: +1. ops: set webhook so registrant -> crm + slack #inbound-webinar channel. tagging rules: if company_size >= 500 -> priority SDR.
Dana R.: creative: test two CTAs in slide deck (contact sales vs try free hosted). capture which converts better via unique tracking link.
Nora-bot: calendar event created: "Practical Inference Economics — final rehearsal" scheduled 2024-06-18T16:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/abc123
Zoe Park: perfect. will draft the email cadence (announce, reminder, last-chance) and share in this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: can marketing ops prep the registration page copy? I'll drop bullet points for the page later today.
Maya Li: slides owners: runtime = Zoe, bench = Ian, demo = Samir, customer = Dana to coordinate with customer. I'll send a checklist template.
Zoe Park: thanks team — next steps: Maya to own checklist, Alex to confirm routing, Dana to draft A/B plan, Samir to prep demo app, Ian to draft benchmark blog outline. share progress by Fri.
Ian Carter: noted. will stub bench blog and share numbers for review.
Maya Li: added checklist to drive and tagged everyone. will schedule rehearsals after decks are in.
Dana R.: scheduling note — run the full dress at 9am PT to catch EU-friendly time window for recordings? open to opinions.
Zoe Park: 9am PT works. we'll record and make clips for social.
Samir Patel: quick ask — can we get an engineer in the greenroom during the live demo for fallback in case of token/timeouts?
Maya Li: yes, will ping eng-oncall.
Zoe Park: OK closing loop: I'll post the promo copy for review in this channel tomorrow. thanks :sparkles:
